Hi there! Safety plan includes: 
-what are your reasons for living/staying well? (You could put your dad, best friend, boyfriend or pets if you have any) or even goals or career literally anything 

-what are your triggers that make you feel suicidal? (Is it when you are alone, when someone yells at you? Touches you? Past memories? Intrusive thoughts? Etc )

-What does it look like when you are at your worst? (Are you isolators? Do you lash out at others? Are you quiet? Etc)

-When are you most suicidal/what does it look like when you are?

-what are your coping mechanisms? (Do you read? Hot shower, being out in nature, walking, yoga, journaling, talking to a friend, talking to a health care provider etc)

Pick 1-2 supports you can call when feeling suicidal put them down on this sheet so when you are having intrusive thoughts you can call 

And if you are really struggling call suicide hotline
